vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showToolbar.never: Never show the inline suggestion toolbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.showToolbar: Controls when to show the inline suggestion toolbar.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.syntaxHighlightingEnabled: Controls whether to show syntax highlighting for inline suggestions in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.suppressSuggestions: Controls how inline suggestions interact with the suggest widget. If enabled, the suggest widget is not shown automatically when inline suggestions are available.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.fontFamily: Controls the font family of the inline suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.allowCodeShifting: Controls whether showing a suggestion will shift the code to make space for the suggestion inline.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.renderSideBySide: Controls whether larger suggestions can be shown side by side.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.inlineSuggest.edits.renderSideByS: Larger suggestions will show side by side if there is enough space, otherwise they will be shown below.
Larger suggestions are never shown side by side and will always be shown below.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineSuggest.edits.showCollapsed: Controls whether the suggestion will show as collapsed until jumping to it.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.bracketPairColorization.enabled: Controls whether bracket pair colorization is enabled or not. Use {0} to override the bracket highlight colors.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.bracketPairColorization.independentColor: Controls whether each bracket type has its own independent color pool.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.bracketPairs.active: Enables bracket pair guides only for the active bracket pair.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.bracketPairs: Controls whether bracket pair guides are enabled or not.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.bracketPairsHorizontal.tru: Enables horizontal guides as addition to vertical bracket pair guides.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.bracketPairsHorizontal.act: Enables horizontal guides only for the active bracket pair.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.bracketPairsHorizontal: Controls whether horizontal bracket pair guides are enabled or not.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.highlightActiveBracketPair: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active bracket pair.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.indentation: Controls whether the editor should render indent guides.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.guides.highlightActiveIndentation: Highlights đang dùng thụt lề guide.
Highlights the active indent guide even if bracket guides are highlighted.
Do not highlight the active indent guide.
Controls whether the editor should highlight the active indent guide.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.insert: Insert suggestion without overwriting text right of the cursor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.replace: Insert suggestion and overwrite text right of the cursor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode: Controls whether words are overwritten when accepting completions. Note that this depends on extensions opting into this feature.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.filterGraceful: Controls whether filtering and sorting suggestions accounts for small typos.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.localityBonus: Controls whether sorting favors words that appear close to the cursor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.shareSuggestSelections: Controls whether remembered suggestion selections are shared between multiple workspaces and windows (needs `#editor.suggestSelection#`).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.always: Always select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.never: Never select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.whenTriggerCharacter: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense from a trigger character.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.insertMode.whenQuickSuggestion: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense as you type.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.selectionMode: Controls whether a suggestion is selected when the widget shows. Note that this only applies to automatically triggered suggestions ({0} and {1}) and that a suggestion is always selected when explicitly invoked, e.g via `Ctrl+Space`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions: Controls whether an active snippet prevents quick suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.showIcons: Controls whether to show or hide icons in suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.showStatusBar: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the suggest widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.preview: Controls whether to preview the suggestion outcome in the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.showInlineDetails: Controls whether suggest details show inline with the label or only in the details widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggest.maxVisibleSuggestions.dep: This setting is deprecated. The suggest widget can now be resized.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.deprecated: This setting is deprecated, please use separate settings like 'editor.suggest.showKeywords' or 'editor.suggest.showSnippets' instead.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.suggest.matchOnWordStartOnly: When enabled IntelliSense filtering requires that the first character matches on a word start. For example, `c` on `Console` or `WebContext` but _not_ on `description`. When disabled IntelliSense will show more results but still sorts them by match quality.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace: Whether leading and trailing whitespace should always be selected.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectSubwords: Whether subwords (like 'foo' in 'fooBar' or 'foo_bar') should be selected.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wordSegmenterLocales: Locales to be used for word segmentation when doing word related navigations or operations. Specify the BCP 47 language tag of the word you wish to recognize (e.g., ja, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW, etc.).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wrappingIndent.none: No indentation. Wrapped lines begin at column 1.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wrappingIndent.same: Wrapped lines get the same indentation as the parent.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wrappingIndent.indent: Wrapped lines get +1 indentation toward the parent.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wrappingIndent.deepIndent: Wrapped lines get +2 indentation toward the parent.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wrappingIndent: Controls the indentation of wrapped lines.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.dropIntoEditor.enabled: Controls whether you can drag and drop a file into a text editor by holding down the `Shift` key (instead of opening the file in an editor).
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.dropIntoEditor.showDropSelector: Controls if a widget is shown when dropping files into the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is dropped.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.dropIntoEditor.showDropSelector.afterDro: Show the drop selector widget after a file is dropped into the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.dropIntoEditor.showDropSelector.never: Never show the drop selector widget. Instead the default drop provider is always used.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.enabled: Controls whether you can paste content in different ways.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.showPasteSelector: Controls if a widget is shown when pasting content in to the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is pasted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.showPasteSelector.afterPaste: Show the paste selector widget after content is pasted into the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.pasteAs.showPasteSelector.never: Never show the paste selector widget. Instead the default pasting behavior is always used.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on commit characters. For example, in JavaScript, the semi-colon (`;`) can be a commit character that accepts a suggestion and types that character.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.acceptSuggestionOnEnterSmart: Only accept a suggestion with `Enter` when it makes a textual change.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.acceptSuggestionOnEnter: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on `Enter`, in addition to `Tab`. Helps to avoid ambiguity between inserting new lines or accepting suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.accessibilityPageSize: Controls the number of lines in the editor that can be read out by a screen reader at once. When we detect a screen reader we automatically set the default to be 500. Warning: this has a performance implication for numbers larger than the default.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggestion: Control whether inline suggestions are announced by a screen reader.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingBrackets.languageDefin: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose brackets.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingBrackets.beforeWhitesp: Autoclose brackets only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoClosingBrackets: Controls whether the editor should automatically close brackets after the user adds an opening bracket.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingComments.languageDefin: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose comments.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingComments.beforeWhitesp: Autoclose comments only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoClosingComments: Controls whether the editor should automatically close comments after the user adds an opening comment.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingDelete.auto: Remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoClosingDelete: Controls whether the editor should remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets when deleting.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingOvertype.auto: Type over closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoClosingOvertype: Controls whether the editor should type over closing quotes or brackets.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingQuotes.languageDefined: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose quotes.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoClosingQuotes.beforeWhitespac: Autoclose quotes only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoClosingQuotes: Controls whether the editor should automatically close quotes after the user adds an opening quote.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoIndent.none: The editor will not insert indentation automatically.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoIndent.keep: The editor will keep the current line's indentation.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoIndent.brackets: The editor will keep the current line's indentation and honor language defined brackets.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoIndent.advanced: The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets and invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoIndent.full: The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets, invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages, and honor indentationRules defined by languages.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoIndent: Controls whether the editor should automatically adjust the indentation when users type, paste, move or indent lines.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoSurround.languageDefined: Use language configurations to determine when to automatically surround selections.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoSurround.quotes: Surround with quotes but not brackets.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.autoSurround.brackets: Surround with brackets but not quotes.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.autoSurround: Controls whether the editor should automatically surround selections when typing quotes or brackets.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.stickyTabStops: Emulate selection behavior of tab characters when using spaces for indentation. Selection will stick to tab stops.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.codeLens: Controls whether the editor shows CodeLens.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.codeLensFontFamily: Controls the font family for CodeLens.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.codeLensFontSize: Controls the font size in pixels for CodeLens. When set to 0, 90% of `#editor.fontSize#` is used.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.colorDecorators: Controls whether the editor should render the inline color decorators and color picker.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.colorDecoratorActivatedOn.clickAn: Make the color picker appear both on click and hover of the color decorator
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.colorDecoratorActivatedOn.hover: Make the color picker appear on hover of the color decorator
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.colorDecoratorActivatedOn.click: Make the color picker appear on click of the color decorator
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.colorDecoratorActivatedOn: Controls the condition to make a color picker appear from a color decorator.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.colorDecoratorsLimit: Controls the max number of color decorators that can be rendered in an editor at once.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.columnSelection: Enable that the selection with the mouse and keys is doing column selection.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.copyWithSyntaxHighlighting: Controls whether syntax highlighting should be copied into the clipboard.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.off: Smooth caret animation là Đã tắt.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.explicit: Smooth caret animation is enabled only when the user moves the cursor with an explicit gesture.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.on: Smooth caret animation is always enabled.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation: Controls whether the smooth caret animation should be enabled.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorStyle: Controls the cursor style in insert input mode.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.overtypeCursorStyle: Controls the cursor style in overtype input mode.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorSurroundingLines: Controls the minimal number of visible leading lines (minimum 0) and trailing lines (minimum 1) surrounding the cursor. Known as 'scrollOff' or 'scrollOffset' in some other editors.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorSurroundingLinesStyle.default: `cursorSurroundingLines` is enforced only when triggered via the keyboard or API.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.cursorWidth: Controls the width of the cursor when `#editor.cursorStyle#` is set to `line`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.dragAndDrop: Controls whether the editor should allow moving selections via drag and drop.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalEditContextEnabled: Sets whether the new experimental edit context should be used instead of the text area.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalGpuAcceleration: Controls whether to use the experimental GPU acceleration to render the editor.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalWhitespaceRendering.svg: Use a new rendering method with svgs.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalWhitespaceRendering.font: Use a new rendering method with font characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.experimentalWhitespaceRendering: Controls whether whitespace is rendered with a new, experimental method.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.folding: Controls whether the editor has code folding enabled.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingStrategy.auto: Use a language-specific folding strategy if available, else the indentation-based one.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingStrategy: Controls the strategy for computing folding ranges.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingHighlight: Controls whether the editor should highlight folded ranges.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingImportsByDefault: Controls whether the editor automatically collapses import ranges.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.foldingMaximumRegions: The maximum number of foldable regions. Increasing this value may result in the editor becoming less responsive when the current source has a large number of foldable regions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfLine: Controls whether clicking on the empty content after a folded line will unfold the line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.formatOnPaste: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the pasted content. A formatter must be available and the formatter should be able to format a range in a document.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.formatOnType: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the line after typing.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.glyphMargin: Controls whether the editor should render the vertical glyph margin. Glyph margin is mostly used for debugging.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.hideCursorInOverviewRuler: Controls whether the cursor should be hidden in the overview ruler.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.letterSpacing: Controls the letter spacing in pixels.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.linkedEditing: Controls whether the editor has linked editing enabled. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags, are updated while editing.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.links: Controls whether the editor should detect links and make them clickable.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseWheelZoom.mac: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Cmd`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.mouseWheelZoom: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Ctrl`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorMergeOverlapping: Merge multiple cursors when they are overlapping.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorModifier.ctrlCmd: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorModifier.alt: Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorModifier: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors with the mouse. vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorPaste.spread: Each cursor pastes a single line of the text.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorPaste.full: Each cursor pastes the full text.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorPaste: Controls pasting when the line count of the pasted text matches the cursor count.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.multiCursorLimit: Controls the max number of cursors that can be in an active editor at once.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlight.singleFile: Highlights occurrences only in the current file.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlight.multiFile: Experimental: Highlights occurrences across all valid open files.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlight: Controls whether occurrences should be highlighted across open files.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.occurrencesHighlightDelay: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which occurrences are highlighted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.overtypeOnPaste: Kiểm soát việc có pasting nên overtype.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.overviewRulerBorder: Controls whether a border should be drawn around the overview ruler.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.peekWidgetDefaultFocus.tree: Focus the tree when opening peek
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.peekWidgetDefaultFocus.editor: Focus the editor when opening peek
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.peekWidgetDefaultFocus: Controls whether to focus the inline editor or the tree in the peek widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.definitionLinkOpensInPeek: Controls whether the Go to Definition mouse gesture always opens the peek widget.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.quickSuggestionsDelay: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which quick suggestions will show up.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renameOnType: Controls whether the editor auto renames on type.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderControlCharacters: Controls whether the editor should render control characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderFinalNewline: Render last line number when the file ends with a newline.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderLineHighlight.all: Highlights both the gutter and the current line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderLineHighlight: Controls how the editor should render the current line highlight.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus: Controls if the editor should render the current line highlight only when the editor is focused.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace.boundary: Render whitespace characters except for single spaces between words.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace.selection: Render whitespace characters only on selected text.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace.trailing: Render chỉ trailing khoảng trắng ký tự.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.renderWhitespace: Controls how the editor should render whitespace characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.roundedSelection: Controls whether selections should have rounded corners.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollBeyondLastColumn: Controls the number of extra characters beyond which the editor will scroll horizontally.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollBeyondLastLine: Controls whether the editor will scroll beyond the last line.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.scrollPredominantAxis: Scroll only along the predominant axis when scrolling both vertically and horizontally at the same time. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectionClipboard: Controls whether the Linux primary clipboard should be supported.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.selectionHighlight: Controls whether the editor should highlight matches similar to the selection.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showFoldingControls.never: Never show the folding controls and reduce the gutter size.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showFoldingControls.mouseover: Only show the folding controls when the mouse is over the gutter.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showFoldingControls: Controls when the folding controls on the gutter are shown.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showUnused: Controls fading out of unused code.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.showDeprecated: Controls strikethrough Đã ngừng dùng Biến.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions.top: Show snippet suggestions on top of other suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions.bottom: Show snippet suggestions below other suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions.inline: Show snippets suggestions with other suggestions.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.snippetSuggestions: Controls whether snippets are shown with other suggestions and how they are sorted.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.smoothScrolling: Controls whether the editor will scroll using an animation.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVerbose: Controls whether the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is shown.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestFontSize: Font size for the suggest widget. When set to {0}, the value of {1} is used.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestLineHeight: Line height for the suggest widget. When set to {0}, the value of {1} is used. The minimum value is 8.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestOnTriggerCharacters: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up when typing trigger characters.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestSelection.first: Luôn luôn chọn đầu gợi ý.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestSelection.recentlyUsed: Select recent suggestions unless further typing selects one, e.g. `console.| -> console.log` because `log` has been completed recently.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestSelection.recentlyUsedByPrefix: Select suggestions based on previous prefixes that have completed those suggestions, e.g. `co -> console` and `con -> const`.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.suggestSelection: Controls how suggestions are pre-selected when showing the suggest list.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.tabCompletion.on: Tab complete will insert the best matching suggestion when pressing tab.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.tabCompletion.off: Tắt Tab gợi ý hoàn thành.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.tabCompletion.onlySnippets: Tab complete snippets when their prefix match. Works best when 'quickSuggestions' aren't enabled.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.tabCompletion: Enables Tab gợi ý hoàn thành.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.unusualLineTerminators.auto: Unusual line terminators are automatically removed.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.unusualLineTerminators.off: Unusual dòng terminators là Bị bỏ qua.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.unusualLineTerminators.prompt: Unusual line terminators prompt to be removed.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.unusualLineTerminators: Remove unusual line terminators that might cause problems.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.useTabStops: Spaces and tabs are inserted and deleted in alignment with tab stops.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.wordBreak.normal: Use the default line break rule.

vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.defaultColorDecorators.auto: Show default color decorators only when no extension provides colors decorators.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.defaultColorDecorators.always: Luôn luôn hiện Mặc định màu decorators.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.editor.defaultColorDecorators.never: Không bao giờ hiện Mặc định màu decorators.

vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.tabFocusMode: Controls whether the editor receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.
vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.commentOnLineNumbers: Enable comment view zone when dragging on line numbers.

vs/editor/common/core/editorColorRegistr.lineHighlightBorderBox: Background color for the border around the line at the cursor position.

vs/editor/common/core/editorColorRegistr.symbolHighlightBorder: Background color of the border around highlighted symbols.
vs/editor/common/core/editorColorRegistr.caret: Màu của trình soạn thảo Cursor.

vs/editor/common/core/editorColorRegistr.editorWhitespaces: Color of whitespace characters in the editor.
vs/editor/common/core/editorColorRegistr.editorLineNumbers: Màu của trình soạn thảo dòng numbers.

vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.browser: Configure the browser to use for opening http or https links externally. This can either be the name of the browser (`edge`, `chrome`, `firefox`) or an absolute path to the browser's executable. Will use the system default if not set.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.titleScrollbarSizing.la: Increases the size, so it can be grabbed more easily with the mouse.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabScrollbarHeight: Controls the height of the scrollbars used for tabs and breadcrumbs in the editor title area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.showTabs.multiple: Each editor is displayed as a tab in the editor title area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.showTabs.single: The active editor is displayed as a single large tab in the editor title area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.showTabs.none: The editor title area is not displayed.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.showEditorTabs: Controls whether opened editors should show as individual tabs, one single large tab or if the title area should not be shown.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation.d: Show editor actions in the window title bar when {0} is set to {1}. Otherwise, editor actions are shown in the editor tab bar.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation.t: Show editor actions in the window title bar.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation.h: Thao tác trình soạn thảo là không được hiện.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.editorActionsLocation: Controls where the editor actions are shown.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.alwaysShowEditorActions: Controls whether to always show the editor actions, even when the editor group is not active.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.wrapTabs: Controls whether tabs should be wrapped over multiple lines when exceeding available space or whether a scrollbar should appear instead. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to '{1}'.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.scrollToSwitchTabs: Controls whether scrolling over tabs will open them or not. By default tabs will only reveal upon scrolling, but not open. You can press and hold the Shift-key while scrolling to change this behavior for that duration. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.highlightModifiedTabs: Controls whether a top border is drawn on tabs for editors that have unsaved changes. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.decorations.badges: Controls whether editor file decorations should use badges.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.decorations.colors: Controls whether editor file decorations should use colors.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.enabled: Controls whether the custom workbench editor labels should be applied.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.patterns: Controls the rendering of the editor label. Each __Item__ is a pattern that matches a file path. Both relative and absolute file paths are supported. The relative path must include the WORKSPACE_FOLDER (e.g `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/src/**.tsx` or `*/src/**.tsx`). Absolute patterns must start with a `/`. In case multiple patterns match, the longest matching path will be picked. Each __Value__ is the template for the rendered editor when the __Item__ matches. Variables are substituted based on the context:
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.dirname: `${dirname}`: name of the folder in which the file is located (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> folder`).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.nthdirname: `${dirname(N)}`: name of the nth parent folder in which the file is located (e.g. `N=2: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/static/folder/file.txt -> WORKSPACE_FOLDER`). Folders can be picked from the start of the path by using negative numbers (e.g. `N=-1: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> WORKSPACE_FOLDER`). If the __Item__ is an absolute pattern path, the first folder (`N=-1`) refers to the first folder in the absolute path, otherwise it corresponds to the workspace folder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.filename: `${filename}`: name of the file without the file extension (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> file`).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.nthextname: `${extname(N)}`: the nth extension of the file separated by '.' (e.g. `N=2: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.ext1.ext2.ext3 -> ext1`). Extension can be picked from the start of the extension by using negative numbers (e.g. `N=-1: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.ext1.ext2.ext3 -> ext2`).
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.customEditorLabelDescriptionExample: Example: `"**/static/**/*.html": "${filename} - ${dirname} (${extname})"` will render a file `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/static/folder/file.html` as `file - folder (html)`.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.label.template: The template which should be rendered when the pattern matches. May include the variables ${dirname}, ${filename} and ${extname}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.default: Show the name of the file. When tabs are enabled and two files have the same name in one group the distinguishing sections of each file's path are added. When tabs are disabled, the path relative to the workspace folder is shown if the editor is active.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.short: Show the name of the file followed by its directory name.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.medium: Show the name of the file followed by its path relative to the workspace folder.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.labelFormat.long: Show the name of the file followed by its absolute path.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabDescription: Controls the format of the label for an editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.untitled.labelFormat.co: The name of the untitled file is derived from the contents of its first line unless it has an associated file path. It will fallback to the name in case the line is empty or contains no word characters.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.untitled.labelFormat.na: The name of the untitled file is not derived from the contents of the file.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.untitledLabelFormat: Controls the format of the label for an untitled editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.empty.hint: Controls if the empty editor text hint should be visible in the editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.languageDetection: Controls whether the language in a text editor is automatically detected unless the language has been explicitly set by the language picker. This can also be scoped by language so you can specify which languages you do not want to be switched off of. This is useful for languages like Markdown that often contain other languages that might trick language detection into thinking it's the embedded language and not Markdown.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.historyBasedLanguageDet: Enables use of editor history in language detection. This causes automatic language detection to favor languages that have been recently opened and allows for automatic language detection to operate with smaller inputs.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.preferBasedLanguageDete: When enabled, a language detection model that takes into account editor history will be given higher precedence.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.showLanguageDetectionHi: When enabled, shows a Status bar Quick Fix when the editor language doesn't match detected content language.

vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabActionLocation: Controls the position of the editor's tabs action buttons (close, unpin). This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabActionCloseVisibilit: Controls the visibility of the tab close action button.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabActionUnpinVisibilit: Controls the visibility of the tab unpin action button.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabSizing.fit: Always keep tabs large enough to show the full editor label.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabSizing.shrink: Allow tabs to get smaller when the available space is not enough to show all tabs at once.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabSizing.fixed: Make all tabs the same size, while allowing them to get smaller when the available space is not enough to show all tabs at once.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.tabSizing: Controls the size of editor tabs. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMinWidth: Controls the minimum width of tabs when {0} size is set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMaxWidth: Controls the maximum width of tabs when {0} size is set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.tabHeight: Controls the height of editor tabs. Also applies to the title control bar when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.pinnedTabSizing.normal: A pinned tab inherits the look of non pinned tabs.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.pinnedTabSizing.compact: A pinned tab will show in a compact form with only icon or first letter of the editor name.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.pinnedTabSizing.shrink: A pinned tab shrinks to a compact fixed size showing parts of the editor name.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.pinnedTabSizing: Controls the size of pinned editor tabs. Pinned tabs are sorted to the beginning of all opened tabs and typically do not close until unpinned. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.pinnedTabsOnSeparateRow: When enabled, displays pinned tabs in a separate row above all other tabs. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.preventPinnedEditorClos: Always prevent closing the pinned editor when using mouse middle click or keyboard.
Prevent closing the pinned editor when using the keyboard.
Prevent closing the pinned editor when using mouse middle click.
Never prevent closing a pinned editor.
Controls whether pinned editors should close when keyboard or middle mouse click is used for closing.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.splitSizingAuto: Splits the active editor group to equal parts, unless all editor groups are already in equal parts. In that case, splits all the editor groups to equal parts.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.splitSizingDistribute: Splits all the editor groups to equal parts.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.splitSizingSplit: Splits the active editor group to equal parts.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.splitSizing: Controls the size of editor groups when splitting them.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.splitOnDragAndDrop: Controls if editor groups can be split from drag and drop operations by dropping an editor or file on the edges of the editor area.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.dragToOpenWindow: Controls if editors can be dragged out of the window to open them in a new window. Press and hold the `Alt` key while dragging to toggle this dynamically.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.focusRecentEditorAfterClose: Controls whether editors are closed in most recently used order or from left to right.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.showIcons: Controls whether opened editors should show with an icon or not. This requires a file icon theme to be enabled as well.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enablePreview: Controls whether preview mode is used when editors open. There is a maximum of one preview mode editor per editor group. This editor displays its filename in italics on its tab or title label and in the Open Editors view. Its contents will be replaced by the next editor opened in preview mode. Making a change in a preview mode editor will persist it, as will a double-click on its label, or the 'Keep Open' option in its label context menu. Opening a file from Explorer with a double-click persists its editor immediately.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enablePreviewFromQuickOpen: Controls whether editors opened from Quick Open show as preview editors. Preview editors do not stay open, and are reused until explicitly set to be kept open (via double-click or editing). When enabled, hold Ctrl before selection to open an editor as a non-preview. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enablePreviewFromCodeNavigation: Controls whether editors remain in preview when a code navigation is started from them. Preview editors do not stay open, and are reused until explicitly set to be kept open (via double-click or editing). This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.closeOnFileDelete: Controls whether editors showing a file that was opened during the session should close automatically when getting deleted or renamed by some other process. Disabling this will keep the editor open  on such an event. Note that deleting from within the application will always close the editor and that editors with unsaved changes will never close to preserve your data.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.editorOpenPositioning: Controls where editors open. Select {0} or {1} to open editors to the left or right of the currently active one. Select {2} or {3} to open editors independently from the currently active one.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.sideBySideDirection: Controls the default direction of editors that are opened side by side (for example, from the Explorer). By default, editors will open on the right hand side of the currently active one. If changed to `down`, the editors will open below the currently active one.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.closeEmptyGroups: Controls the behavior of empty editor groups when the last tab in the group is closed. When enabled, empty groups will automatically close. When disabled, empty groups will remain part of the grid.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.revealIfOpen: Controls whether an editor is revealed in any of the visible groups if opened. If disabled, an editor will prefer to open in the currently active editor group. If enabled, an already opened editor will be revealed instead of opened again in the currently active editor group. Note that there are some cases where this setting is ignored, such as when forcing an editor to open in a specific group or to the side of the currently active group.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.mouseBackForwardToNavigate: Enables the use of mouse buttons four and five for commands 'Go Back' and 'Go Forward'.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.navigationScope: Controls the scope of history navigation in editors for commands such as 'Go Back' and 'Go Forward'.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.navigationScopeDefault: Navigate across all opened editors and editor groups.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.navigationScopeEditorGr: Navigate only in editors of the active editor group.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.navigationScopeEditor: Navigate only in the active editor.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.restoreViewState: Restores the last editor view state (such as scroll position) when re-opening editors after they have been closed. Editor view state is stored per editor group and discarded when a group closes. Use the {0} setting to use the last known view state across all editor groups in case no previous view state was found for a editor group.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.sharedViewState: Preserves the most recent editor view state (such as scroll position) across all editor groups and restores that if no specific editor view state is found for the editor group.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.splitInGroupLayout: Controls the layout for when an editor is split in an editor group to be either vertical or horizontal.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.splitInGroupLayoutVerti: Editors are positioned from top to bottom.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.splitInGroupLayoutHoriz: Editors are positioned from left to right.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.centeredLayoutAutoResize: Controls if the centered layout should automatically resize to maximum width when more than one group is open. Once only one group is open it will resize back to the original centered width.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.centeredLayoutDynamicWidth: Controls whether the centered layout tries to maintain constant width when the window is resized.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.doubleClickTabToToggleEditorGroupSizes: Controls how the editor group is resized when double clicking on a tab. This value is ignored when {0} is not set to {1}.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.editor.doubleClickTabToToggleE: All other editor groups are hidden and the current editor group is maximized to take up the entire editor area.
The editor group takes as much space as possible by making all other editor groups as small as possible.
No editor group is resized when double clicking on a tab.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.limitEditorsEnablement: Controls if the number of opened editors should be limited or not. When enabled, less recently used editors will close to make space for newly opening editors.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.limitEditorsMaximum: Controls the maximum number of opened editors. Use the {0} setting to control this limit per editor group or across all groups.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.limitEditorsExcludeDirty: Controls if the maximum number of opened editors should exclude dirty editors for counting towards the configured limit.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.perEditorGroup: Controls if the limit of maximum opened editors should apply per editor group or across all editor groups.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.localHistoryEnabled: Controls whether local file history is enabled. When enabled, the file contents of an editor that is saved will be stored to a backup location to be able to restore or review the contents later. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.localHistoryMaxFileSize: Controls the maximum size of a file (in KB) to be considered for local file history. Files that are larger will not be added to the local file history. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.localHistoryMaxFileEntries: Controls the maximum number of local file history entries per file. When the number of local file history entries exceeds this number for a file, the oldest entries will be discarded.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.exclude: Configure paths or [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) for excluding files from the local file history. Glob patterns are always evaluated relative to the path of the workspace folder unless they are absolute paths. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.mergeWindow: Configure an interval in seconds during which the last entry in local file history is replaced with the entry that is being added. This helps reduce the overall number of entries that are added, for example when auto save is enabled. This setting is only applied to entries that have the same source of origin. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.commandHistory: Controls the number of recently used commands to keep in history for the command palette. Set to 0 to disable command history.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.preserveInput: Controls whether the last typed input to the command palette should be restored when opening it the next time.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.suggestCommands: Controls whether the command palette should have a list of commonly used commands.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.askChatLocation: Controls where the command palette should ask chat questions.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.askChatLocation.chatView: Ask chat questions in the Chat view.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.askChatLocation.quickChat: Ask chat questions in Quick Chat.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.enableNaturalLanguageSearch: Controls whether the command palette should include similar commands. You must have an extension installed that provides Natural Language support.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.closeOnFocusLost: Controls whether Quick Open should close automatically once it loses focus.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.quickOpen.preserveInput: Controls whether the last typed input to Quick Open should be restored when opening it the next time.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.workbench.quickOpen.width: Controls the width in pixels of Quick Open and other quick pickers.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openDefaultSettings: Controls whether opening settings also opens an editor showing all default settings.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.useSplitJSON: Controls whether to use the split JSON editor when editing settings as JSON.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.openDefaultKeybindings: Controls whether opening keybinding settings also opens an editor showing all default keybindings.
vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribut.sideBarLocation: Controls the location of the primary side bar and activity bar. They can either show on the left or right of the workbench. The secondary side bar will show on the opposite side of the workbench.

Controls nesting of files in the Explorer. {0} must be set for this to take effect. Each __Item__ represents a parent pattern and may contain a single `*` character that matches any string. Each __Value__ represents a comma separated list of the child patterns that should be shown nested under a given parent. Child patterns may contain several special tokens:
- `${capture}`: Matches the resolved value of the `*` from the parent pattern
- `${basename}`: Matches the parent file's basename, the `file` in `file.ts`
- `${extname}`: Matches the parent file's extension, the `ts` in `file.ts`
- `${dirname}`: Matches the parent file's directory name, the `src` in `src/file.ts`
- `*`:  Matches any string, may only be used once per child pattern

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.inputHeader: Inside the Terminal Find Input (What It Does):
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.inputDesc: While you are in the Terminal Find input, your focus stays in the field. You can type, edit your search term, or navigate matches without leaving the input. When you navigate to a match, the terminal scrolls to show it, but your focus remains in the Find input.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hearDesc: Each navigation step gives you a complete spoken update:
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hear1: 1) The full line that contains the match is read first, so you get immediate context.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hear2: 2) Your position among the matches is announced, so you know how far you are through the results.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.hear3: 3) The exact line and column are announced, so you know precisely where the match is in the buffer.
vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.focusDesc1: When you navigate from the Terminal Find input, the terminal buffer updates in the background while your focus stays in the input. This is intentional, so you can keep refining your search without losing your place.

vs/workbench/contrib/terminalContrib/fin.terminal.focusDesc3: If you want to close Find and return focus to the terminal command line, press Escape. Focus moves to the command input at the bottom of the terminal.

See {0} for configuring if the 'Zoom In' and 'Zoom Out' commands apply the zoom level to all windows or only the active window.

vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.window.newWindowDimensions.fullscreen: Open new windows in full screen mode.

vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.closeWhenEmpty: Controls whether closing the last editor should also close the window. This setting only applies for windows that do not show folders.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.window.doubleClickIconToClose: If enabled, this setting will close the window when the application icon in the title bar is double-clicked. The window will not be able to be dragged by the icon. This setting is effective only if {0} is set to `custom`.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.titleBarStyle: Adjust the appearance of the window title bar to be native by the OS or custom. On Linux and Windows, this setting also affects the application and context menu appearances. Changes require a full restart to apply.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.controlsStyle: Adjust the appearance of the window controls to be native by the OS, custom drawn or hidden. Changes require a full restart to apply.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.dialogStyle: Adjust the appearance of dialog windows.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.window.nativeTabs: Enables macOS Sierra window tabs. Note that changes require a full restart to apply and that native tabs will disable a custom title bar style if configured.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.window.nativeFullScreen: Controls if native full-screen should be used on macOS. Disable this option to prevent macOS from creating a new space when going full-screen.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.window.clickThroughInactive: If enabled, clicking on an inactive window will both activate the window and trigger the element under the mouse if it is clickable. vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.disableHardwareAcceleration: Disables hardware acceleration. ONLY change this option if you encounter graphic issues.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.forceColorProfile: Allows to override the color profile to use. If you experience colors appear badly, try to set this to `srgb` and restart.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.enableCrashReporter: Allows to disable crash reporting, should restart the app if the value is changed.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.crashReporterId: Unique id used for correlating crash reports sent from this app instance.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.enebleProposedApi: Enable proposed APIs for a list of extension ids (such as `vscode.git`). Proposed APIs are unstable and subject to breaking without warning at any time. This should only be set for extension development and testing purposes.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.logLevel: Log level to use. Default is 'info'. Allowed values are 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug', 'trace', 'off'.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.disableChromiumSandbox: Disables the Chromium sandbox. This is useful when running VS Code as elevated on Linux and running under Applocker on Windows.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.useInMemorySecretStorage: Ensures that an in-memory store will be used for secret storage instead of using the OS's credential store. This is often used when running VS Code extension tests or when you're experiencing difficulties with the credential store.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.enableReactDevTools: Load the React Developer Tools extension so Chrome DevTools shows the Components and Profiler tabs. Internal packaged builds (lab) bundle the extension and default this on; set false to turn it off. Dev builds default off; the React DevTools switch in Settings > Developer turns it on. Other builds default off and additionally need a locally installed extension cache. Requires a restart.
vs/workbench/electron-sandbox/desktop.co.argv.force-renderer-accessibility: Forces the renderer to be accessible. ONLY change this if you are using a screen reader on Linux.
